name: Saint-Malo to Guadeloupe
description: Sailed alongside the fleet of the Route du Rhum (13th edition): solo transat, Saint-Malo to Pointe-à-Pitre, ~3,542 nm. Start 12:02 UTC (13:02 local) Sun 1 Nov 2026 with the real gun, on a line north of the Pointe du Grouin. Course as the 2026 Notice of Race gives it: through the Cap Fréhel gate, then the open Channel and Biscay (the Sept-Îles and Ushant marks only keep the default line at sea), across the Atlantic to round Guadeloupe leaving the island to port — the Tête à l'Anglais islet to port at the north of Basse-Terre, down the leeward west coast, the Basse-Terre buoy to starboard off the town, round Vieux-Fort and beat back up to the finish off Pointe-à-Pitre. Trade-wind route vs. great circle is the whole game. Polar: Class40 (meltemus.com) at 90% — the Ultims and IMOCAs will be quicker; everyone sails the same numbers.
